title: Rector of BSU named after K. Karasaev spoke at an international symposium in China with a report on the strategy for the development of energy in KyrgyzstanReport of the Rector of BSU

blocks.text: On May 13, the rector of the Bishkek State University named after K. Karasaev, Professor Mirlan Dyldaev, made a report at the plenary session of the symposium on international exchange and cooperation in the field of high-quality energy development, held in the city of Urumqi, People's Republic of China. The topic of his speech was "The Strategy of the Kyrgyz Republic in the Field of High-Quality Energy Development."
